# Yiwu Shuihui Import & Export Co., Ltd. (SOLA Hardware)
> Factory direct manufacturer of door hardware and building materials.
> Exporting to Nigeria, Dubai, Africa since 2015.
> Website: https://jh-hardware.com

## Company Info
- **Company**: Yiwu Shuihui Import & Export Co., Ltd.
- **Brand**: SOLA Hardware
- **Location**: Yiwu, Zhejiang, China (Factory)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001, CE, SGS
- **MOQ**: Door handles 400 pcs, Door locks 1000 pcs, Hinges 1000 pairs
- **Delivery**: 3-5 days stock, 15-25 days custom
- **Payment**: T/T, L/C
- **Shipping**: Ningbo port → Lagos/Dubai (15-35 days)
- **Documentation**: Form M, SONCAP, PAAR, COC support

## Target Markets
- Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Ethiopia, South Africa
- UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait
- 50+ countries worldwide

## Product Categories
- Door Locks: Padlocks, Mortise locks, Cylindrical locks
- Door Handles: Stainless steel, Zinc alloy, Aluminum
- Door Hinges: Butt hinges, Spring hinges, T-hinges
- Sliding Tracks: Drawer slides, Sliding door tracks
- Building Materials: Steel pipes, Flanges, Curtain rods
- Cabinet Hardware: Handles, Knobs, Pulls
- Furniture Fittings: Sofa legs, Table legs
- Door Accessories: Door closers, Stoppers, Security chains
